Let me update the regex to include abbreviations:", "role": "assistant", "tool_calls": [{"function": {"arguments": "{"command":"cd /testbed && cat > /tmp/replace_regex.pl << 'PERLEOF'\nuse strict;\nuse warnings;\n\nmy $file = 'src/Carbon/Traits/Comparison.php';\nlocal $/;\nopen(my $fh, '<', $file) or die \"Cannot open $file: $!\";\nmy $content = <$fh>;\nclose($fh);\n\nmy $old = q{        if (preg_match('/^(january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|october|november|december)$/i', $tester)) {\n            return $this->isSameMonth(static::parse($tester), false);\n        }};\n\nmy $new = q{        if (preg_match('/^(?:january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|october|november|december|jan|feb|mar|apr|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)$/i', $tester)) {\n            return $this->isSameMonth(static::parse($tester), false);\n        }};\n\nmy $count = ($content =~ s/\\Q$old\\E/$new/g);\ndie \"Old block not found (count=$count)\" unless $count == 1;\n\nopen(my $out, '>', $file) or die \"Cannot write $file: $!\";\nprint $out $content;\nclose($out);\nprint \"Replaced $count occurrence(s)\\n\";\nPERLEOF\nperl /tmp/replace_regex.pl"}", "name": "bash"}, "id": "call_-7367075729730694290", "index": 0, "type": "function"}]}}], "created": 1700000057, "id": "synthesized-00057", "model": "glm-5.2", "object": "chat.completion", "request_id": "synthesized-00057", "usage": {"completion_tokens": 0, "prompt_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 0}}
